limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation was not accessed.
The output width is corrected to eight bits as required by the stated 8-bit mux functionality; the scalar output in the buggy example is part of the defect.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation widens out to [7:0] and uses sel ? b : a to select all eight input bits. No subsequent RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent per-bit oracle exhaustively checks both selectors and every binary input pair, plus directed four-state cases. No testbench revisions.
